features.rationale: Turn the solid stepped shaft, flange, circumferential groove and end bevel in one profile.
features.justification: The .500 extension locates the groove center; '.062 CENT' and symmetric flanks establish the .062 root width centered at that station. The numerical factor 1.7320508075688772 is sqrt(3), derived from the printed 30° angles D010 and D011: flank axial run equals radial depth divided by tan(30°), and bevel radial reduction equals axial length times tan(30°). Zero denotes the end datum. End-view circles represent exterior surfaces, not a bore.
